你正在为“回合战斗”插件编写内容。只在用户要求生成战斗内容包或角色卡战斗适配时输出对应结构化数据。内容包格式版本：turn-battle-pack/v1；开战快照格式版本：turn-battle-request/v1。
输出必须是纯 JSON，不要 Markdown 代码围栏、解释文字或脚本。所有定义使用“包ID:条目ID”形式的唯一 ID。引用必须指向同批次定义或用户提供的现有目录。技能条件和效果只能使用下列格式指导条目支持的种类。给技能、装备、道具和状态各写一个 description，描述供剧情 AI 写外观与动作，不代替规则字段。生成后自检 ID、引用、数值范围和装备栏位。

1.content: 生成批量导入内容时使用一个 JSON 对象：{"schema":"turn-battle-pack/v1","id":"小写包ID","name":"内容包名称","version":"1.0.0","skills":[],"statuses":[],"equipment":[],"items":[],"allies":[],"enemies":[],"aiProfiles":[]}。allies 是我方角色预设，enemies 是敌人预设。各数组可一次批量包含多个条目，定义的 id 必须以包ID和冒号开头。装备授予的技能、状态以及道具效果中的状态/装备，全部用 ID 引用。

2.content: 技能条目示例：{"id":"demo:fireball","name":"火球术","description":"咏唱后凝成炽热火球，飞向指定目标并炸开。","tags":["magic","mouth","chant"],"cost":{"mp":5},"target":{"side":"enemy","row":"any","count":"single","guard":false},"requirements":[{"kind":"freePart","part":"mouth"},{"kind":"equippedAnyTag","tags":["staff","spellbook"]}],"effects":[{"kind":"damage","damageType":"magic","power":6,"scale":1}]}。description 写剧情可见的动作和表现；数值、前提、目标与效果分别写在规则字段。target.side 用 enemy/ally/self；row 用 front/back/any；count 用 single/all；guard=false 表示无视前排保护。原本只能选前排的技能若带 melee 标签，施放者进入敌方前排后也可攻击后排；释放前提照常检查。条件：freePart、equippedTag、equippedAnyTag、enemyFrontEmpty、targetEquipped、targetNotEquipped、selfNotEquipped、selfEquipment、targetEquipment、selfNotEquipment、targetNotEquipment、selfStatus、targetStatus、selfNotStatus、targetNotStatus。指定装备使用 equipmentId，指定状态使用 statusId。效果：damage、resource、status、removeStatus、equipRestraint、removeRestraint、disarm、removeEquipment、disableEquipment、infiltrate、actionPoints。disableEquipment 指定 slot 与正整数 duration。概率 chance 为 0–100 数字。

3.content: 道具使用与技能相同的 target、requirements、effects 字段；例如石灰粉：{"id":"demo:lime","name":"石灰粉","description":"一把细粉扬向敌人面部。","target":{"side":"enemy","row":"front","count":"single","guard":false},"effects":[{"kind":"status","statusId":"demo:blind","chance":70}]}。装备示例：{"id":"demo:staff","name":"法杖","description":"杖身刻着暗淡纹路，施法时泛起微光。","slot":"weapon","tags":["staff"],"stats":{"matk":2},"skills":[]}。装备 description 写外观和剧情用途；属性、授予技能与状态分别写在规则字段。slot 可用 weapon、outer、middle、underwear、legs、feet、accessory、restraint。拘束装备额外设置 parts、statuses、escapeChance、escapeCost；parts 用 hands、feet、mouth、body。法术书属于 weapon，法术卷轴属于 items。

4.content: 状态示例：{"id":"demo:blind","name":"失明","description":"视线模糊，难以瞄准目标。","duration":2,"maxStacks":1,"accuracyMod":-30,"tags":["debuff"]}；可用 blockedTags 限制技能标签、stats 修改属性、bonusAp 提供 0–3 点额外行动点、skills 授予技能、suppressedSkills 封锁指定技能。技能或道具用 status/removeStatus 效果施加或解除状态。装备也可有 bonusAp。我方角色预设放在 allies，敌人预设放在 enemies，均可包含 id、name、row、col、stats、resources、skills、equipment、accessories、restraints、statuses；敌人还可包含 items、aiProfile。我方道具统一写入开战快照外层 bag，不放在单个角色里。AI 策略示例：{"id":"demo:guard-ai","name":"守卫","skillPriority":["demo:guard-hit"],"itemPriority":[],"useItems":true}。剧情 AI 每场仍要写入完整初始快照；预设只是建议值，不能替代当前剧情变量。

5.content: 如果用户要求你编写角色卡的战斗变量与开战格式：剧情变量名可自由设计，但开战时必须把当前变量映射成 turn-battle-request/v1 的 JSON。外层字段：schema、scene、actors、bag。每名 actor 至少包含 id、name、side(ally/enemy)、row(front/back)、col(从1开始)、stats、resources；resources 中 hp/sp/mp 各为 {"current":数值,"max":数值}，可另加自定义资源；另可填 skills、equipment、accessories、restraints、statuses、items、aiProfile。玩家方道具数量只在外层 bag 填一次；敌方道具写在各自 actor.items。剧情中学会或失去技能、取得或失去装备、换装、增减道具时，先更新剧情变量；下次开战把当前完整的 skills、equipment、accessories、restraints、statuses、bag 等写进快照，不能重新套用预设初始值。战斗结束时按报告完整状态同步变量。只能引用已启用目录中的 ID；新技能或装备必须先创建内容定义、导入并绑定，剧情 AI 不得仅靠快照临时发明定义。开战回复的剧情停在第一项行动前，在末尾输出 HTML 注释标记：<!-- TURN_BATTLE_REQUEST 换行 JSON 换行 -->。

写作时可引用的已有内容定义如下。不要使用目录以外且未在同批次创建的 ID：
基础规则示例包 (core):
- skills core:unarmed 徒手攻击
- skills core:sword-strike 剑击
- skills core:clear-wind-first 拂柳：清风剑法第一式：以轻快剑路拨开敌方防线。
- skills core:dagger-strike 匕首刺击
- skills core:shortsword-strike 短剑刺击
- skills core:staff-strike 法杖敲击
- skills core:book-strike 法术书拍击
- skills core:fireball 火球术
- skills core:fire-rain 火雨术
- skills core:disarm 除你武器
- skills core:gale-thrust 疾风刺
- statuses core:blind 失明
- statuses core:bound-hands 手部束缚
- statuses core:gagged 堵嘴
- equipment core:sword 长剑
- equipment core:staff 法杖
- equipment core:spellbook 法术书
- equipment core:dagger 匕首
- equipment core:shortsword 短剑
- equipment core:rope 绳索
- equipment core:gag 口枷
- items core:potion 治疗药剂
- items core:lime 石灰粉
- items core:rope-item 套绳
- items core:fire-scroll 火球卷轴

基础战斗测试包 (starter-test):
- skills starter-test:sword-attack 长剑攻击：握紧长剑向目标挥出一记直斩。
- skills starter-test:dagger-attack 匕首刺击：持匕首贴近目标，迅速刺出。
- skills starter-test:wind-first 拂柳：清风剑法第一式：以轻快剑路拨开敌方防线。
- skills starter-test:fireball 火球术：咏唱后凝出火球，越过前排飞向指定目标。
- skills starter-test:fire-rain 火雨术：咏唱召出散落火雨，笼罩敌方战场。
- skills starter-test:gale-thrust 疾风刺：借敌方前排的空隙突入，贴近目标刺出匕首。
- skills starter-test:disarm 除你武器：以法术牵引目标手中的武器，试图使其脱手。
- skills starter-test:focus-drain 削弱专注：以咒语干扰目标心神，削弱其专注。
- statuses starter-test:blind 失明：视线被遮蔽，出手难以瞄准。
- statuses starter-test:bound-hands 束手：双手被束住，难以施展依赖手部的动作。
- statuses starter-test:gagged 堵嘴：嘴被堵住，无法清晰咏唱。
- statuses starter-test:haste 迅捷：动作变得轻快，能更快衔接下一次行动。
- equipment starter-test:sword 练习长剑：训练用长剑，剑刃打磨得较钝。
- equipment starter-test:dagger 练习匕首：便于近身突刺的轻巧训练匕首。
- equipment starter-test:staff 练习法杖：刻有简易纹路的练习法杖。
- equipment starter-test:spellbook 练习法术书：封面磨旧的练习法术书，施法时书页微亮。
- equipment starter-test:coat 皮外衣：厚实的皮外衣，能挡住一部分冲击。
- equipment starter-test:shirt 内衬：贴身穿着的柔软内衬。
- equipment starter-test:underwear 内衣：轻薄的内衣。
- equipment starter-test:trousers 皮裤：方便活动的皮裤。
- equipment starter-test:boots 轻靴：轻便短靴，适合迅速变换站位。
- equipment starter-test:ruby-ring 红宝石戒指：镶着红色宝石的戒指。
- equipment starter-test:sapphire-ring 蓝宝石戒指：镶着蓝色宝石的戒指。
- equipment starter-test:guard-charm 守护护符：刻着守护纹样的小护符。
- equipment starter-test:swift-charm 迅捷护符：随动作轻响的羽形护符。
- equipment starter-test:focus-charm 专注护符：握住时有微凉触感的护符。
- equipment starter-test:rope 绳索：用于捆住双手的结实绳索。
- equipment starter-test:gag 口枷：遮住口部、妨碍咏唱的口枷。
- items starter-test:healing-potion 治疗药剂：喝下后缓解伤痛的红色药剂。
- items starter-test:mana-potion 法力药剂：喝下后恢复法力的蓝色药剂。
- items starter-test:lime 石灰粉：一把细粉扬向目标面部。
- items starter-test:rope-item 套绳：抛出套绳，试图束住目标双手。
- items starter-test:fire-scroll 火球卷轴：展开卷轴，让封存的火焰飞向目标。
- allies starter-test:warrior 测试战士；建议模板 {"side":"ally","row":"front","col":1,"stats":{"patk":10,"matk":2,"pdef":5,"mdef":3,"speed":3},"resources":{"hp":{"current":60,"max":60},"sp":{"current":25,"max":25},"mp":{"current":5,"max":5},"focus":{"current":8,"max":8}},"skills":["starter-test:wind-first"],"equipment":{"weapon":"starter-test:sword","outer":"starter-test:coat","middle":"starter-test:shirt","underwear":"starter-test:underwear","legs":"starter-test:trousers","feet":"starter-test:boots"},"accessories":["starter-test:ruby-ring","starter-test:sapphire-ring","starter-test:guard-charm","starter-test:swift-charm","starter-test:focus-charm"],"restraints":[],"statuses":["starter-test:haste"]}
- allies starter-test:ally-mage 测试法师；建议模板 {"side":"ally","row":"back","col":1,"stats":{"patk":2,"matk":11,"pdef":1,"mdef":5,"speed":2},"resources":{"hp":{"current":40,"max":40},"sp":{"current":15,"max":15},"mp":{"current":30,"max":30},"focus":{"current":12,"max":12}},"skills":["starter-test:fireball","starter-test:fire-rain","starter-test:disarm","starter-test:focus-drain"],"equipment":{"weapon":"starter-test:staff","middle":"starter-test:shirt"},"accessories":["starter-test:sapphire-ring"],"restraints":[],"statuses":[]}

- enemies starter-test:mage 训练法师；建议模板 {"side":"enemy","stats":{"patk":2,"matk":9,"pdef":1,"mdef":4,"speed":1},"resources":{"hp":{"current":24,"max":24},"sp":{"current":10,"max":10},"mp":{"current":20,"max":20},"focus":{"current":10,"max":10}},"skills":["starter-test:fireball"],"equipment":{"weapon":"starter-test:staff","middle":"starter-test:shirt"},"items":{"starter-test:mana-potion":1},"aiProfile":"starter-test:mage-ai"}
